interpretation: Each fixture is compared with its own original XPU render at the same sampling settings.
Four-sample replacement used 2952 GPU worker batches versus 11680 serial batches; repeat used 2942.
Nine-sample replacement used 3326 GPU worker batches versus 26271 immediate serial batches; repeat used 3479.
Nine-sample replacement and repeat recorded 10 and 81 kernel-window CPU-light observations. These are polling observations, not durations or utilization percentages.
Observed Mcrt times are heavily instrumented: nine-sample original 0.355s, immediate serial 11.967s, replacement 2.764s and repeat 2.883s. No speedup over existing XPU is established.
CPU reference shading remains duplicated; native GPU pointer ownership, general materials, live revisions, full-path suspension and production lifecycle are not established.
The unchanged 219-test unit suite was not rerun for this native-only change. Nineteen native render cases and six standalone guard processes were run.
